The affix घञ् is optionally used after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with प्र when the word so formed means 'a rein'.

Terms: घञ्

The affixes घ and ख are respectively added after the words 1. राष्ट् and 2. अवारपार।

Terms: घ and ख

The affix मतुप् comes in the sense of 'whose it is' or 'in whom it is' after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) रस etc.

Terms: मतुप्

After न् and ष् , the ण् is the substitute of न् , when they occur as component letters in the same word.
